discipline_just_cause_001.evidence: Discipline of teachers including but not necessarily limited to dismissal, reprimand, or suspension, shall be for just cause.

discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: Progressive discipline consists of a conference summary, caution, reprimand, suspension without pay, and dismissal. [For non-renewal:] This notification shall not be later than four (4) weeks prior to the end of the post-school year. The Area Superintendent and the Assistant Superintendent for Human Resources will determine the appropriateness... Such determination shall be in their sole discretion...
